summary: Frontend regression test for the two reported bugs. FIX 1 (video maior + tela cheia) and FIX 2 (relay do circulo end-to-end) both confirmed working via headless Playwright with two browser tabs (tecnico + cliente).
critical_code_review_comments: tecnico.js click handler correctly does letterbox-aware mapping (object-fit: contain) and falls back to raw rect when videoWidth/Height are 0 (case in headless without real stream) — good.
cliente.js mostrarCirculo uses window.innerWidth/innerHeight for placement which is correct given tecnico sends percentages of the video content area.
video-caixa has min-height:62vh and :fullscreen rule to fill the screen — matches the fix spec.

Minor: video-ecra element with no stream is only ~150px tall (letterboxed inside 62vh caixa) — clicks still work because video-espera has pointer-events:none. Fine for real usage (real stream fills the box).
seed_data_creation: One ephemeral session created by opening /cliente.html?op=<linkId> during test; cleared via btn-limpar before test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Two-tab flow works reliably in this env. Key checks: video-caixa height >= 0.62*viewport (measured 669.6px on 1080 viewport); btn-fullscreen sets document.fullscreenElement (works headless with fake-media Chromium flags); technician click -> server relay -> client .circulo-toque appears in DOM within <200ms; marca-clique-tec loses 'oculto' class on tecnico side.
verified_scenarios: Client tab connects and appears as Online in tecnico CRM (data-testid=sessao-<id>)
Click on video-ecra shows marca-clique-tec on tecnico side
Same click triggers .circulo-toque element in client DOM (socket relay end-to-end)
